exposure: International Society of Ultrasound in Obstetrics and Gynecology (ISUOG)-endorsed Delphi consensus criteria for late FGR
Fetal growth restriction diagnosis (SMFM criteria, ISUOG/Delphi criteria, both, neither)
Fetal growth restriction (diagnosed by SMFM and ISUOG/Delphi criteria)
outcome: Emergency cesarean section for non-reassuring fetal status
cohort: Singleton infants born at term to women who delivered at the Mater Mother's Hospital, Brisbane, Australia, between January 2014 and December 2020
finding: Both the Society for Maternal-Fetal Medicine (SMFM) and International Society of Ultrasound in Obstetrics and Gynecology (ISUOG)/Delphi criteria had strong screening potential for detecting infants with birth weight below the 10th or 3rd percentile but not for adverse neonatal outcomes.
